# Dolman Law Group

> Legal representation for product liability and mass tort cases including Tylenol autism lawsuits and Gerber baby food contamination claims.

Dolman Law Group specializes in mass tort litigation and class action lawsuits, with particular focus on pharmaceutical and consumer product safety cases. The firm handles multidistrict litigation (MDL) cases involving acetaminophen health claims and heavy metals contamination in baby food products.
